cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Stay Until We’re Okay
cards.instruction: Keep someone present until the relationship feels repaired, even if the practical reason for staying disappears.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Right, kitchen finished. We'll sit down now and sort out that argument before you go.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I said I'd stay to wash up. I've done that.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You have. No more jobs. I'll make the tea, and you can tell me what I got wrong. We'll get this settled.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I can stay ten minutes, then I have to catch the last bus.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Nine, then. I'll keep an eye on the clock. You start; I'll save my side for another day if I have to. I'd rather have you come back than win the whole argument tonight.
